permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Your position drives the minimap, street name, speed, heading and the destination tracker. It is used on your phone only and never stored or sent to us.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Fetches OpenStreetMap road data (Overpass API), street names / destination search (Nominatim) and the current temperature (Open-Meteo). Only your current coordinates are sent to those services.
